title: LUCID: Local Understanding of Covariate Importance with Conditional Density Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computing local-level variable importance (VI) is critical for understanding machine learning models. Local permutation-based VI metrics offer a simple yet powerful approach, measuring how much a model's output changes when perturbing its inputs. However, existing perturbation strategies often ignore feature dependence or account for it only through restricted approximations. Perturbing a feature without fully respecting this dependence can generate unrealistic counterfactuals, thereby evaluating the model in regions unsupported by the observed data distribution. We address this gap by introducing a new model-agnostic local VI metric and estimator, Local Understanding of Covariate Importance with conditional Density estimation (LUCID). LUCID perturbs features of interest using plausible values drawn from the full conditional distribution given the remaining observed features. We establish theoretical connections between LUCID and exist

translated_title: LUCID：基于条件密度估计的协变量重要性局部理解
translated_abstract: 计算局部层面的变量重要性（VI）对于理解机器学习模型至关重要。基于局部置换的VI指标提供了一种简单而强大的方法，通过衡量扰动模型输入时输出变化的大小来评估变量的重要性。然而，现有的扰动策略往往忽略特征之间的依赖关系，或仅通过受限的近似来考虑这种依赖。在不充分尊重这种依赖关系的情况下扰动特征，可能会产生不真实的反事实样本，从而在观测数据分布无法支撑的区域上评估模型。我们通过提出一种新的模型无关的局部VI指标和估计器来填补这一空白，即基于条件密度估计的协变量重要性局部理解方法（LUCID）。LUCID通过从给定其余已观测特征条件下完整条件分布中抽取的合理取值来扰动目标特征。我们建立了LUCID与现有方法之间的理论联系……
tldr: 提出LUCID，一种模型无关的局部变量重要性指标，通过从给定其余特征的完整条件分布中采样来扰动目标特征，从而尊重特征间依赖关系，避免在不真实区域评估模型。
en_tdlr: LUCID is a model-agnostic local variable importance metric that perturbs features by sampling plausible values from their full conditional distribution given the remaining observed features, thereby respecting feature dependence and avoiding unrealistic counterfactuals.
